name: Credit spreads
summary: US high-yield spreads 3.32%, inside the 4% Watch line
state: The US high-yield option-adjusted spread was 3.32% on 4 Nov, about 29bp wider than a month earlier and close to its widest in a year, but inside the 4% Watch line (FRED). There is no sign of a broad credit squeeze as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Corporate borrowing costs remain contained; wider spreads would signal tighter credit for riskier firms.
rubric_hit: HY OAS 3.48% below the 4% Watch line
why: High-yield spreads show how much lenders demand to fund weaker companies — an early warning of defaults and credit crunches.
drivers: Default expectations, risk appetite, rates, private-credit stress, fund outflows.

rubric.alert: HY OAS > 6.0%, or widened > 200bp in a month.
rubric.watch: HY OAS 4.0–6.0%, or widened > 100bp in a month.
